mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_history (user_id, keyword, searched_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT search_id AS searchId, user_id AS userId, keyword, searched_at AS searchedAt FROM search_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY searched_at DESC, search_id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM search_history WHERE search_id = #{searchId} AND user_id = #{userId}
